about.heading: Bridging Technical SEO expertise with Data-Driven strategies
about.bio1: As a Senior SEO Specialist, I have been optimizing websites and crafting content strategies since 2022. My extensive background spans across all branches of digital marketing and search visibility. I excel at conducting in-depth SEO Audits, improving Core Web Vitals, and implementing Semantic SEO best practices. I understand exactly how Search Engine Algorithms evaluate websites, focusing on User Intent and Entity Optimization.
about.bio2: My biggest strength is my analytical, data-driven approach. I leverage professional SEO tools like Ahrefs, Semrush, and Google Search Console to uncover high-intent Long-tail Keywords and LSI keywords. I specialize in Pillar Content creation, Local SEO, and E-commerce SEO for Shopify, WordPress, Salla, and Zid, ensuring long-term sustainable growth rather than black-hat quick fixes.
